preservation_rule: UTF-16 code-unit length remains the exact Java boundary.
Code-point count preserves valid surrogate-pair and lone-unit behavior.
ASCII/Latin-1/Unicode classification flags retain explicit bit assignments.
Hash is a candidate signal only; exact content remains semantic authority.
Bit presence can reject candidates only and may collide.
Similarity distance is ranking metadata and never equality authority.
Packed lexical lanes are saturated counters plus stable flags; overflow cannot change exact semantics.
Keyword hits are candidate score input, not a parser result.
Score is bounded routing evidence only; no promotion authority.
Score is bounded routing evidence only; JDK Pattern remains semantic authority.
MinHash is cloned on output and used only for approximate candidate ranking.
